unmapped.reason: The additional FN4 actual mass >80t restriction is not inferred from a profile MTOW; actual taxi mass is outside this wingspan catalogue.

Obstacle clearance strip widths and the list of TWYs narrower than23m are not converted into fictitious wingspan limits. Wingtip clearance, oversteering and obstacle height require a separate physical model.
Towing approvals on M/B/BM3/BM5/BM6/EM7/EM8 do not authorize autonomous taxi and do not bypass route exclusions. Towing remains a separate unmodelled mode.
Engine thrust procedures and simultaneous bridge occupancy cannot be established by a static wingspan check; no such authorization is implied.

limitations: The chart is schematic; only reviewed existing source chains are selected.
B747-400 and B747-8 are distinct profiles. The >65m rule does not apply to B747-400 merely because its family name is B747.
Orange/blue lane mode enforces its published 36m restriction but does not create two offset physical tracks in the single-centreline graph.
Stand aircraft-capacity compatibility is not inferred from a terminal name.
Current NOTAM and real controller clearances are not downloaded in real time.
